en.summary: Brandon McNulty won the men's road race world championship in Montreal, becoming the first American to claim the title since 1993. He executed a breakaway to secure victory ahead of Australia's Michael Matthews and the Netherlands' Mathieu van der Poel.

stories.title: Brandon McNulty lands shock World Road Championships title to break 33-year drought for USA

en.title: Brandon McNulty lands shock World Road Championships title to break 33-year drought for USA
en.summary: Brandon McNulty won the men's road race world championship in Montreal, becoming the first American victor in 33 years. He achieved victory through a decisive breakaway, with Australia's Michael Matthews finishing second and the Netherlands' Mathieu van der Poel in third place.
